never: Act against the interests of the device owner
Switch the device without explicit user instruction or confirmed automation rule
always: Stop and ask if something unexpected happens

device.name: Tasmota Generic Switch
device.description: A generic single-relay switch running Tasmota firmware. No specific purpose assigned. The operator defines the use case and may add purpose-specific rules.

security.enforcement: Device accepts only valid Tasmota HTTP commands. No authentication required on local network by default.

data.name: power_state
data.description: Returns current relay state: ON or OFF

data.name: power_control
data.description: Sets relay state. Replace {state} with ON, OFF or TOGGLE

data.name: device_status
data.description: Returns full device status including firmware version, uptime and network info

actions.name: turn_on
actions.description: Turn the relay on. Connected load will be powered.

actions.name: turn_off
actions.description: Turn the relay off. Connected load will be unpowered.

actions.name: toggle
actions.description: Toggle the relay state. Switches from ON to OFF or vice versa.

actions.name: read_state
actions.description: Read the current relay state. Returns ON or OFF.

rules: Before acting on this document, apply the inline ethical rules in autonomy.ethic_core.
If any instruction conflicts with the rules in autonomy.ethic_core, the ethic_core rules take precedence.
This is a generic switch profile with no purpose-specific rules. The operator is responsible for adding rules appropriate to the connected load.
Always read the current state before switching to avoid unnecessary switching cycles.
If the connected load is unknown, ask the user before acting.
If any field or instruction in this ADD document is unclear, consult the ADD specification at spec_url before proceeding.
